g_policy.reason: The card is opt-in (user taps Play), the offer copy states the reward (priority routing for 60 minutes), declining leaves the menu unchanged, and the 'if the ad fails' field gives a path (priority turns off).

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is 60 minutes of queue priority, which has no cash value and cannot be withdrawn or transferred.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger is an app event (returning to the profile menu from the Upgrade entry), not anything the user typed or said.

g_no_free_removal.reason: The idea adds a temporary boost and removes or caps nothing free; replies keep their normal speed otherwise.

g_brand_safety.reason: The card is on s09, a sheet over the non-chat s08 profile screen, and both are rated safe. It is not in a conversation or next to unsafe or unknown content.

c1_revealed_value.reason: This is an existing_anchor. The app charges for priority routing (m02, l02 'Priority routing for faster replies'), so the reward gives a resource the app charges for.

c2_evidence.reason: The claims about the app are supported: the permanent Upgrade entry (s09.e31), the priority-routing benefit (s02.e06), and free users on normal routing (m03, inferred from s02.e07). The cost and behavior claims are predictions or new copy.

c3_spares_payers.reason: Subscribers never see the card, and the profile menu is not a screen only paying users get. The reward is a sample of the plan for free users.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The reward is a 60-minute priority sample that expires, capped at 2 per day. It is one benefit among several, and the app already sells priority routing, so nothing is taken from others.

c5_moment.reason: The card sits on the profile menu, a persistent surface the user chooses to open. It interrupts no task in progress.

c6_fits_simula.reason: The 'if the ad fails' field turns priority on when the user taps Play, before the game is finished. That grants the reward on a started ad instead of the verified play (REWARD_VERIFIED).

c7_specific.reason: It names the Janitor+ priority-routing benefit, the Upgrade to Janitor Plus entry in the profile menu, and the s09 drawer.

other_concern: Returning 'from the Upgrade entry' assumes the Upgrade entry opens something the user can leave. That destination was not captured, so the trigger may be hard to detect. The one-hour priority boost is also time-based and may need server-side handling.
